name: Storm's End
description: Ancient storm-proof seat of House Baratheon, raised by legend against the wrath of the gods. Renly and Stannis parleyed beneath its walls, Melisandre birthed the shadow in the caves below, and Gendry was legitimized its lord by King Bran's council era.

name: Evenfall Hall
description: Seat of House Tarth on the Sapphire Isle — Brienne's home, which she left behind for Renly's colors and never truly returned to.

name: Summerhall
description: Burned summer palace of the Targaryens, where a king died trying to wake dragons from eggs. A ghost story by the show's era, known from Targaryen history.

name: Blackhaven
description: Seat of House Dondarrion in the Dornish Marches — Beric's home, which he left on Ned Stark's errand and never saw again.

name: Nightsong
description: March castle of House Caron guarding the passes into Dorne. Book background only.

name: Haystack Hall
description: Seat of House Errol in the stormland interior. Book background; never seen in the show.

name: Bronzegate
description: Castle of House Buckler on the road between King's Landing and Storm's End. Book background only.

name: Felwood
description: Keep of House Fell in the rainwood's northern reaches. Book background only.

name: Griffin's Roost
description: Cliff-perched seat of the exiled House Connington on Cape Wrath. Central to a book plotline the show cut entirely.

name: Rain House
description: Storm-lashed castle of House Wylde on the rainwood coast. Book background only.

name: Greenstone
description: Seat of House Estermont on its island off the stormland coast — kin to Robert Baratheon's mother. Book background only.

name: Weeping Tower
description: Lonely watchtower of the stormland coast. Book background only.

name: Mistwood
description: Castle of House Mertyns deep in the rainwood. Book background only.

name: Stonehelm
description: Seat of House Swann above the Slayne in the marches. Balon Swann serves in the books' Kingsguard; the show leaves the family behind.

name: Crow's Nest
description: Keep of House Morrigen in the stormland hills. Book background only.

name: Grandview
description: Holdfast town of House Grandison. Book background only.

name: Parchments
description: Seat of House Penrose on the stormland coast. Book background only.
